get.description: Returns aggregate market statistics and listing trends for a single US zip code.

parameters.name: dataType
parameters.description: The type of aggregate market data to retrieve. Defaults to `"All"` if not provided

parameters.name: historyRange
parameters.description: The time range for historical record entries, in months. Defaults to `12` if not provided

value.message: No API key provided in request. An API key must be provided in the 'X-Api-Key' header
